//: Far Territory plan P13 part 1 (Documentation/Plans/FarTerritory/MASTER_PLAN.md section 13, pack Prompt 24): the island's seagull. Card Survival: Tropical Island puts it on Bird Rock, the Desolate Beach and the Rocks (Documentation/Research/FarTerritory/csti_inventory.md section 3, 'You see a Seagull!'); this mod's names for those are Gull Stack, Bleak Strand and Boulder Shore (island_layout.md). A GENERATED agent (no Agent.Ref). CSTI's seagull raids on food are NOT built: there is no raid counter (owner Q6, the plan's Considered row on seagull raids). Its bite lands as the base game's W_BiteWound. The gulls' nest on Gull Stack is a separate forage card, ft_seagull_nest. Every number is a TUNABLE PLACEHOLDER.
//Flight: Gull Stack is reached on the map only by swims, which carry the climb travel tag that every generated agent's pathfinding refuses, so a WanderEnvs list would strand the gull on whichever side it started. The gull flies instead: three CustomDuties of equal weight (ties are broken uniformly, InGameNPC.SelectDuty) each TELEPORT it to one of its three boards and wait 4 to 8 ticks there, valid 05:00 to 20:00. By night it roosts on Gull Stack (an on-stage roost).
